architecture: Distribution sits between emission and generation: it receives the useful energy required downstream (Q_*_dis_out_kWh, normally the emission input Q_H_em_in_kWh) and returns the energy the generator must supply (Q_*_dis_in_kWh), the thermal losses and the pump auxiliary electricity.

It can be configured on TWO levels. Level 1: flat keys inside the HVAC dict of HeatingSystemCalculator (heating only), in one of two modes chosen by 'distribution_calculation_mode' (simplified | analytical). Level 2: DistributionSystemCalculator, used standalone or fed to Level 1 through 'distribution_15316_3_config'; it handles heating, cooling and DHW.
Energy balance per service: Q_in = Q_out + Q_losses - Q_aux_recovered_by_fluid (clipped at 0). For cooling the recoverable terms change sign.
notes: Every key is optional (cfg.get with a default).
Most numeric inputs are silently clipped at 0 (max(value, 0)); only eei and *_fraction keys are clipped at [0, 1], and time_step_hours must be > 0.

The water volumetric heat capacity is not identical everywhere: 1.15 kWh/(m3 K) in DistributionSystemCalculator, 1.163 in the fast path of HeatingSystemCalculator and c_w = 1.16 in its emission/simplified code.

level_1_heating_system_distribution_keys.usage: Keys of the flat HVAC dict passed to pybuildingenergy.HeatingSystemCalculator (they live next to the emission and generation keys).

distribution_calculation_mode.description: Any other value fails an assertion at construction time.

distribution_operation_time.description: Operating hours per step (tH_dis_i_ON). In analytical flat mode it is also used as time_step_hours.

heat_losses_recovered.description: false disables the recoverable share of the losses.

recoverable_losses.description: System recoverable losses (QW_sys_ls_rbl_tz_i) subtracted from the emission demand before it enters the calculation.

distribution_loss_coeff.description: Global loss coefficient: losses [kWh] = (T_mean_pipes - T_internal) * coeff / 1000 * operation_time. T_mean = (supply + return) / 2.

distribution_aux_power.description: Pump electric power; auxiliary [kWh] = operation_time * power / 1000 * distribution_aux_recovery / 100.

distribution_aux_recovery.description: Share of the auxiliary energy that reduces the generator input.

distribution_loss_recovery.description: Share of the losses that is recovered in the heated space.

simplified_approach.description: If exactly 0, no losses are treated as recoverable (any other value only acts as an on/off switch).

simplified_mode.balance: Q_dis_in = Q_em_in + losses - aux - recoverable_losses; flow V = Q_dis_in / (c_w * (supply - return) * operation_time).

analytical_mode.description: Runs DistributionSystemCalculator step by step. The configuration comes from ONE of the two sources below.

source_A_full_dict.description: A complete DistributionSystemCalculator config (see level_2). When it is a dict it is used as is and all flat distribution_* keys below are ignored.

source_B_flat_keys._note: Used only when no config dict is supplied: the code builds a single 'heating' pipe section from these keys. Nominal power = emission nominal_power; time step = distribution_operation_time; supply/return temperatures = the values of the current step; operation_mode is always 'demand'.

distribution_length_m.description: Straight pipe length; also used as max_length_m for the pump head.

distribution_loss_coeff.description: CAUTION: in analytical flat mode this same key becomes the linear thermal transmittance psi of the section (not W/K). With the default 1 m length the result equals the simplified W/K value; if you raise distribution_length_m keep or lower this value accordingly.

distribution_design_flow_m3_h.description: 0 = derive from nominal power and delta-T.

source_B_flat_keys.heat_losses_recovered: same key as in common; sets the section 'recoverable' flag

time_step_hours.description: Fallback when the input has neither time_step_hours/dt_h nor a DatetimeIndex.

demand_unit.description: Unit of the RAW demand columns (Q_H, Q_C, Q_W ...). Columns already named *_kWh are kWh.

service_blocks._note: All three blocks share the same keys. A missing block is treated as an empty block (no pipes, no pump energy, zero losses).

pipe_sections.description: Pipe stretches, each with its own insulation and surrounding temperature.

ambient_temperature_C.description: Temperature of the space crossed by the pipe (heated room, basement, outdoors ...).

recoverable.description: true = losses of this stretch are recoverable in the heated space (counted in Q_dis_th_rbl).

description.demand: Operating hours = time step whenever the demand > 0, else 0.
description.continuous: Always operating (all hours of the step).
description.fixed_fraction:<x>: Operating hours = time step * x, e.g. 'fixed_fraction:0.5'.

part_load_mode.description: 'load': beta = q_out / hours / nominal_power clipped to [0, 1]. 'constant_when_on': beta = 1 whenever the system operates.

nominal_power_kW.description: Reference power for beta and for the design flow. 0 = the maximum hourly power found in the input data.

max_length_m.description: Hydraulic path length used for the pump head.

resistance_ratio.description: Share of extra resistances (fittings) added to the pipe head.

design_delta_pressure_kPa.description: If > 0 it replaces the head computed as (1 + resistance_ratio) * pressure_loss_per_m_kPa * max_length_m + additional_pressure_kPa.

pump_control_code.description: Selects the constants cp1, cp2 (see pump_control_constants). Codes without their own constants use the code-4 ones.

eei.description: Energy Efficiency Index of the pump; scales the expenditure factor by eei / 0.25.

pump_label_power_kW.description: If > 0: pump efficiency factor f_e = label power / hydraulic design power.

pump_selection_factor.description: Used as f_e (min 1.0) when no label power is given and the hydraulic power is outside 1-2500 W.

recoverable_aux_fraction.description: Share of the pump auxiliary energy recoverable as heat in the space; the remaining share is recovered by the fluid and reduces Q_in.

pump_control_constants.formula: epsilon = f_e * (cp1 + cp2 / beta) * eei / 0.25 ; W_hydr = P_hydr_des * beta * operating_hours * hydraulic_correction_factor ; W_aux = W_hydr * epsilon ; P_hydr_des [kW] = delta_p [kPa] * design_flow [m3/h] / 3600
pump_control_constants.f_e_rule: label power / P_hydr if pump_label_power_kW > 0; else (1.7 P + 17 (1 - exp(-0.3 P)))/P with P in W when 1 W < P < 2500 W; else max(pump_selection_factor, 1).
pump_control_constants.no_pump_energy_when: hydraulic power <= 0, i.e. no design flow or no head (no pipe_sections/max_length_m and no additional_pressure_kPa/design_delta_pressure_kPa).
pump_control_constants.note: The code does not label the control codes; only their (cp1, cp2) pairs are defined.

losses_and_signs: Heating and DHW: loss per section [kWh] = psi * (length + equivalent length) * max(T_mean - T_ambient, 0) * operating_hours / 1000
Cooling: the temperature difference is max(T_ambient - T_mean, 0)
Cooling: recoverable thermal losses and recoverable/recovered auxiliary energy are reported with NEGATIVE sign

timeseries_input.index: DatetimeIndex recommended (time step inferred from the median spacing).

optional_temperature_overrides.description: Per-row values replacing the constant temperatures of the service block.

timeseries_input.note: Chaining: pass the emission output column 'Q_H_em_in_kWh' (EmissionSystemCalculator.timeseries) as the heating demand.

simplified_default.description: Level 1 simplified distribution: 48 W/K global coefficient, 30 W pump, 90% of the losses recovered.

analytical_flat_keys.description: Level 1 analytical mode built from flat keys: one 25 m pipe (psi 0.25 W/mK) running in a 15 degC unheated space.

analytical_detailed_dict.description: Level 1 analytical mode with a full DistributionSystemCalculator dict (two pipe sections: risers in heated space + basement run).

standalone_heating_cooling_dhw.description: DistributionSystemCalculator on its own for a residential building with heating, chilled-water cooling and a DHW recirculation loop.

pump_with_label_power_and_fixed_head.description: Heating circuit where the pump label power and the design head are known (both override the estimated values).

continuous_operation_uninsulated_basemen.description: Worst case: pump always on (continuous), pipes crossing an unheated basement, losses not recoverable.
